test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is the Sixth largest country of the world in terms of area?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Australia**__ is one of the seven continents on Earth.

 __
 
• It is the **smallest continent** on Earth.
 
• Australia is the **sixth-largest country** in the world in terms of area.
 
• The total area of Australia is about **7,617,930 square kilometres (2,941,300 sq mi).**
 
• Australia is lying between the Pacific and Indian oceans in the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• **Canberra** is the capital city of Australia.
 
• "The Oldest Continent," "The Last of Lands," and "The Last Frontier" have all been used to describe Australia.
 
• **Australian Dollar** is the currency of Australia.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Russia** is the world's largest country, spanning 17,098,250 km² over Eastern Europe and Asia.
 
• **Brazil** is the world's fifth-largest country by area.
 
• **China** is the third-largest country by area after Russia and Canada,
 
• **India** is the seventh-largest country by area.
